title: bowtie summary
description: Summarized output from a Bowtie test run.
$todo: Add surrounding metadata for the run, which probably turns this into an object.
Can we make `bowtie summary --show foo --schema` show only the relevant subschema?

oneOf.title: Test Results
oneOf.description: A summary of the results collected for each test case.

anyOf.title: Validation Test Case Results
anyOf.description: Results for a test case asserting validity.

prefixItems.title: JSON Schema
prefixItems.description: The schema which validated this test case.
Results across all instances which were tested.

items.title: Instance Result
items.description: The result of validation for a specific instance across implementations.

prefixItems.title: Instance
prefixItems.description: The instance which was validated in this test.

prefixItems.title: Per-implementation Validation Results
prefixItems.description: The results of validation for each implementation which was run.

additionalProperties.$todo: Include more of the actual result details.

anyOf.title: Annotation Test Case Results
anyOf.description: Results for a test case asserting annotations.

schema.title: JSON Schema
schema.description: The schema whose annotations this test case asserts on.

tests.description: Results across all instances which were tested.

instance.title: Instance
instance.description: The instance which was annotated in this test.

results.title: Per-implementation Annotation Results
results.description: The annotation results for each implementation which was run.

status.description: Whether the produced results matched the test's expectations.

expected.description: What the test expected -- for annotation assertions, the expected annotations grouped by instance location and keyword, and otherwise the expected validity.

actual.description: The annotations the implementation produced, grouped by instance location and keyword.

oneOf.title: Test Failures
oneOf.description: A summary of which validation results did not succeed against what was expected by the test case.
